title: The export scan passes a plain option key in a mockup's script
why: export_page.py's credential-name shape refused a q_max mockup for `key: 'icon-compact'` and `key: 'tight-compact'`, plain option keys (triage, page item 403, 00:20 CST Nov 8). A false alarm teaches the reader to scroll past the scan.
note: Fix: the letters-only branch of credential-name skips a value of lower-case words joined by hyphens; red test first on `key: 'icon-compact'`, and a real secret still refuses. Queue fix, so the item 384 hold lets it start (coordinator, 00:14 CST Nov 8; owner 13:20 CST Nov 7, a found gap gets a fix). Title by triage. Filed 00:16 CST Nov 8.
